value: Law of Obligations Act (Võlaõigusseadus), lease of dwellings (§ 272 and following).
source_publisher: Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs of Estonia
note: Cross-check page is the Riigi Teataja English version of the act as published on 12.01.2021; it was used for the section list only.

value: A dwelling lease may require a security deposit of up to three months of rent; a larger deposit may not be claimed and the tenant may refuse to pay it.
source_publisher: Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs of Estonia

value: A lease for an unspecified term can be cancelled in the ordinary way with at least three months notice; a fixed-term lease can be ended early by the landlord only in an exceptional case such as breach by the tenant.
source_publisher: Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs of Estonia

value: The landlord may increase rent of a dwelling on the grounds provided by law every year after conclusion of the lease, giving at least 30 days notice stating the new rent, the date it takes effect, the justification and calculation, and how to contest it.
source_publisher: Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs of Estonia

value: A periodic increase agreed in advance must be set as a specific amount, percentage or index, the lease must run at least three years, and rent may not rise more often than once a year.
source_publisher: Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs of Estonia
